description: REPLACE a Cloud for WordPress site's files and database with one files backup (`fs_id`) and one database backup (`db_id`) from list_wordpress_backups; anything changed since is lost. Run it with `dry_run: true` first and confirm the exact backup dates with the user. The restore is queued: the site is unavailable for a few minutes and the account holder is emailed when it finishes. Poll get_hosting (`wordpress.site.operations`) until its state is `done`.

domain.description: Domain of the Cloud for WordPress site, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

staging.description: true: act on the site's staging copy instead of the live site.

name: restore_wordpress_backup
title: Restore Wordpress Backup
